name: qBitrr
description: A simple script to monitor qBit and communicate with Radarr and Sonarr

paths.name: Sonarr Database
paths.description: Path to Sonarr database. This is only needed if you want episode search handling.

paths.name: Radarr Database
paths.description: Path to Radarr database. This is only needed if you want movie search handling.

paths.name: Completed Downloads
paths.description: Path to completed downloads to monitor.

variables.name: Restart Timer
variables.description: Number of hours after which to restart the child processes (set 0 to disable).
